metadata.description: Le skill della Prompt Library di CH Labs e il plugin vocale bazinga per Claude Code.

plugins.name: tutte-le-skill
plugins.description: All 13 skills of the CH Labs Prompt Library in one install.

plugins.name: 007-founders-nations
plugins.description: Find the countries the founders of companies, products or tools come from (nationality, birth country or where they grew up), each claim backed by a verbatim quote in a JSONL ledger. Use when the user asks where founders come from, who founded a list of tools, or wants founder nationalities checked.

plugins.name: 007-headquarters-cities
plugins.description: Find the cities of up to three main headquarters of companies, products or tools, written as City (Country) in rank order, each backed by a verbatim quote in a JSONL ledger. Use when the user asks where a company is based, where its main offices or headquarters are, or wants that data checked.

plugins.name: 3d-decoration-asset
plugins.description: 3D and animated web assets made from a reference image or a prompt, with cloud generation through Runware by default. Use when a site needs a mascot that follows the cursor, a 360° or scroll-scrubbed object sequence, a looping clip or a GLB model built, generated or integrated.

plugins.name: ai-crawler-access
plugins.description: Audit and fix AI crawler access to a site, from robots.txt and Vercel or Cloudflare edge blocks to content that only appears with JavaScript. Use when ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity should cite a site (AEO, GEO), or when the user wants AI training bots blocked.

plugins.name: audio-transcription
plugins.description: Transcribe speech from a local audio or video file (mp3, m4a, wav, ogg, opus, flac, webm, aac, aiff, mp4, mov) with Voxtral 3 through OpenRouter, with optional timestamps. Use when the user attaches or names a recording, voice note, meeting, interview or podcast whose words the task needs.

plugins.name: design-system-refactor
plugins.description: Refactor a frontend design system with zero visual change: tokens, shared components, guardrails, in any framework. Use when the user asks to refactor or clean up a design system, theme, tokens or component library, or to remove hardcoded styles and duplicated UI.

plugins.name: filtra-stile-linguistico
plugins.description: Ripulisce tono, lessico e punteggiatura di testi in prosa e propone un secondo passaggio editoriale mirato. Usa quando l'utente chiede di filtrare lo stile, ridurre i tic di scrittura da IA o applicare queste preferenze alla stesura di un testo.

plugins.name: gerarchia-editoriale-impaginazione
plugins.description: Rivede la gerarchia visiva di pagine già scritte secondo il significato dei testi, conservando ciò che funziona.

plugins.name: iai
plugins.description: IAI, Identità Agente Impersonale: le due metà, Tiziano e Michelangelo Boccaccini, dietro le richieste. Usa quando una richiesta nomina IAI, Tiziano o Michelangelo, chiede una biografia, un profilo o il contesto di uno dei due per una proposta di collaborazione o una candidatura, o chiede di firmare come uno dei due.

plugins.name: metadati-dadastickers
plugins.description: Gives each subpage its own title, description and share-preview text, pairing plain page facts with a verbatim Dadastickers statement.

plugins.name: riassunto-per-sottrazione
plugins.description: Condensa un testo nella lingua originale tagliando soltanto incisi e rami secondari. Conserva parola per parola il filo principale, le sue ragioni e la direzione del discorso. Usa quando l'utente chiede un riassunto per sottrazione, un riassunto senza parafrasi o un compendio che mantenga intatte le parole dell'autore.

plugins.name: stack-update
plugins.description: Update outdated dependencies and tools after a compatibility check and the user's approval. Use when the user asks to update, upgrade or bump this project (scope Project), several or all projects (scope Batch), or Bun, Node, global Bun tools, Homebrew tools or IDE command-line tools (scope Machine toolchain).

plugins.name: voice-check
plugins.description: Check AI-generated speech (ElevenLabs or any TTS) against its script and a real voice: words not read as written, lines in the wrong character's voice, drift, and a 0-100 fidelity score per voice-clone take, with a free offline mode. Use when the user wants a generated voice track checked or voice-clone takes compared and ranked.

plugins.name: bazinga
plugins.description: Voice mode for Claude Code: "bazinga on" reads replies aloud in your ElevenLabs voice, "bazinga off" stops it, the mic then listens for your spoken answer, and a row above the prompt shows credits and dollars spent.
